lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical lines visible; spacing is non-uniform, with narrower gaps in the posterior region and wider spacing toward the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the fifth line from the posterior, approximately one-third down from the dorsal line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, and 5 from the posterior terminate as abbreviated segments before reaching the lower ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: One primary high-contrast circular spot on the lower posterior haunch with two smaller, lower-contrast spots located immediately dorsal to it.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes, two white spots on the cheek, and a white patch at the base of the throat.
